claim: The Apple M3 Max chip provides exactly 50% faster CPU performance across all computer programs compared to M2 Max.

annotation.adjudication_rationale: The original claim claimed an absolute 50% gain in all programs, whereas Apple officially qualified it as 'up to 50% in select benchmarks' and independent benchmarks confirmed 15-25% in typical workloads.

gold_evidence.exact_quote: M3 Max features CPU performance that is up to 50 percent faster than M2 Max in select benchmark tasks.
Across standard productivity and single-threaded workloads, the M3 Max measures 15% to 25% faster than M2 Max.
